requirements: No paste on J1/J2/J3/J5/J6/J7/J8/J9, SW1/SW2/SW3, D4, H1-H4 or TP1-TP14. Hand-solder through-hole items after SMT.

No F.Paste or B.Paste on J4 shell slots for shell hand-soldering. Only A1/A4/A9/A12 carry paste for their shared copper areas; B12/B9/B4/B1 suppress duplicate apertures without changing copper or mask.

Use a 0.100 mm laser-cut stencil and native 1:1 copper-shaped apertures with zero local paste margins for every remaining active SMT pad. This is the selected board process, not a claim to reproduce TI's separate 0.125 mm DBV example. Check actual aperture area ratios and preserve nine independent U1 ground windows.

initial_grid.mapping: Separate strictly monotone X/Y map for each electrical sheet, canonical native integer coordinates, preserving every orthogonal wire, pin, label, junction and NC incidence. No nearest-coordinate merge. Preserve two-field junction/NC at syntax.
initial_grid.branch_junctions: Add explicit dots only where all incident wires already connect through shared endpoints, positive collinear overlap or existing junctions. Current source-derived branch dots prevent native Save from disconnecting branches when merging collinear stubs. Unconnected crossings or endpoint-on-interior contacts are never inferred as net ties.
initial_grid.display: Map symbol body polylines and field anchors, retaining font/stroke sizes and circle radii. Explicit joined four-lobe L1 display repair leaves all electrical pin anchors, lengths and types unchanged. Zero-length power flag definitions stay rigid.
initial_grid.verification: Require identical native XML components, pin names/types, all 63 named nets/303 connected pins/12 NCs. Preserve every original wire and junction; add only proven branch dots. Current enabled ERC findings must be empty both initially and after native GUI save of a disposable copy; native wire merging may change segment counts but not connectivity. The before-routing saved report must include excluded findings and no ignored categories. Inspect complete pages and L1/module/USB/test-pad/flag details.
initial_grid.remaining: Source label islands resolve the prior J4 ground and module page/label crossings. Full native page review, strict saved ERC and current exact parity are still required for each adoption candidate.
